rng: CPython random.Random MT19937 with random() and Box-Muller normals

design.purpose: controlled seeded sensitivity, not historical evidence or a stochastic optimality claim
design.path_rule: For one family configuration and seed, generate one 60-month path plus its month-60 evaluation price; 12- and 36-month episodes are exact prefixes ending at their corresponding evaluation prices.
design.common_random_numbers: Each primary/exploratory pair uses the same three saved integer seeds. Family algorithms consume their own documented stream, so pairing is exact within a family algorithm and descriptive across different algorithms.
design.primary_rule: One baseline configuration per required family was chosen before executing this saved design.
design.exploratory_rule: One named sensitivity changes the declared family characteristic and remains separate from primary summaries; every outcome is retained.
design.evaluation_rule: H monthly deposits occur at the H generated purchase prices and terminal wealth is evaluated one month after the final deposit at generated price H.
design.cost_and_policy_rule: Execute every preregistered primary coverage, primary corrected-mean, and cost configuration for DCA, neutral guarded, and corrected guarded policies.

parameter_interpretation.trend: Annual log-diffusion drift spans -6% to +6% with 15% annual volatility.
parameter_interpretation.mean_reversion: Log-price half-life spans 3 to 12 months around a USD 100 long-run level with 15% stationary log-price volatility.
parameter_interpretation.stochastic_volatility: Long-run annual volatility spans 15% to 35%, with 0.9 monthly log-volatility persistence and 0.2 stationary log-volatility dispersion.
parameter_interpretation.regime_switching: Bull and bear states use +10%/-12% annual drift and 12%/25% annual volatility; sensitivities change monthly state persistence from 96%/85% to 85%/95%.
parameter_interpretation.jump_diffusion: Negative log jumps average -12% with 8% dispersion; monthly jump arrival probability spans 4% to 12% over a 6%-drift, 12%-volatility diffusion.
